provenance.prompt:
Create a native detailed PIXEL-ART ANIMATION SPRITE ATLAS for adult VEGETA from DRAGON BALL Z, matching the attached game references for identity and outfit. Tall upright BLACK flame-shaped spiky hair with widow's peak, adult muscular compact build, stern face. Exact costume in EVERY cell: fitted DARK BLUE SLEEVELESS training top and matching blue trousers, bare muscular upper arms, WHITE gauntlet gloves, WHITE boots with GOLD toe caps. NO chest armor, NO shoulder armor, NO brown Saiyan skirt, NO scouter, NO tail, NO Majin M, NO Super Saiyan or yellow/blue hair, NO red aura, NO weapon. Newly drawn project animation adaptations, not official source-game frames. All bodies face RIGHT in a side/three-quarter view; natural hip/shoulder rotations allowed. EXACTLY FOUR columns. Every state must have FOUR genuinely different sequential anatomical poses, not merely recolored, scaled or shifted copies. Keep the entire black hair, all gloved fingers and both golden boot tips INSIDE the individual cell, with transparent separation gutters on every side. Full adult body in every frame. Transparent RGBA background: NO floor, shadows, stage, rock, painted ledge, grid, labels, text, numbers or border. No body aura, no long effects crossing cells. EXACTLY EIGHT ROWS × FOUR COLUMNS =32 full-body sprites. Portrait1:2 canvas ideally1024×2048. Allocate eight complete evenly spaced rows, each small enough to fit, including row8. Do not combine or omit rows. Grounded states have their soles on the same baseline within their row. GALICK GUN is the purple two-handed beam: both cupped white-gloved hands gather together BESIDE THE REAR SHOULDER/CHEEK at head height, elbows folded, torso coiled; release thrusts BOTH palms together toward the right. Purple/magenta energy, never a yellow Final Flash and never a single-palm round Kikoha orb. NO hands gathered at a hip. Final Flash belongs to a different existing super atlas and must not appear here.
ROW1 attackLight1: compact left jab. Frame1 left fist guarding chin and rear fist close to ribs; frame2 lead elbow half extends and lead knee sinks; frame3 full straight left punch to right with rotated shoulder and rear hand guarding; frame4 punching elbow retracts into wide guard. Four distinct elbow/knee postures.
ROW2 attackLight2: right cross. Rear fist pulled beside ribs and torso coils; rear shoulder turns forward and heel rises; full right cross with long forward arm, lead fist still guarding jaw, front knee lunges; torso untwists and both fists return to cheek level.
ROW3 attackLight3: rising uppercut. Deep squat with rear fist low; bent elbow rises before chest and one heel lifts; right fist rises above face with torso lengthened and front knee pushing upward; uppercut elbow folds and weight settles in high guard. No energy.
ROW4 crouchLight: four LOW crouched body-punch stages. Deep crouched guard; left glove half thrusts at waist level; glove fully extends low while opposite fist covers face and bent knees stay low; both elbows fold back into low guard. Never stand fully upright in this row.
ROW5 chargeStart: physical Galick Gun setup WITHOUT a blast. Guard with fists in front; torso rotates away as BOTH hands open beside upper rear shoulder; hands cup together beside the cheek with elbows deeply bent and knees wide; hips coil farther back, cupped hands lift slightly above shoulder and body braces. Four clearly different torso/elbow/leg angles. No glow needed.
ROW6 chargeLoop: HELD Galick Gun bracing, NOT release. All four keep BOTH cupped hands beside rear shoulder/head, elbows BENT. Frame1 wide stance with rear knee loaded and paired palms beside cheek; frame2 deeper squat with lead knee turned out and elbows tucked; frame3 torso coils farther back and elbows lift, rear heel planted; frame4 body rises slightly and both elbows fold inward while hands remain beside shoulder. Anatomically distinct holding postures; no straight arms, projectile or beam.
ROW7 chargeRelease: Galick Gun. Frame1 paired palms beside rear cheek with knees low; frame2 both elbows halfway straighten toward right, small PURPLE glow between palms; frame3 BOTH ARMS fully thrust together rightward and a SHORT PURPLE BEAM emerges from paired palms, purple core only about40pixels long contained inside cell, rear leg braces and front knee lunges; frame4 beam is completely gone, both elbows recoil toward chest and torso leans back into guard. No round projectile. No yellow blast. Full body and whole beam contained.
ROW8 chargeRecovery: recovery after paired-palm beam. Frame1 both arms low-forward and body leaning into follow-through; frame2 both elbows pull toward ribs and front knee bends deeper; frame3 torso rises and hands separate into fists; frame4 steady upright wide martial guard with both fists raised. Four actual distinct anatomy poses. Reserve all32poses, do not omit held charge row.
